notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “I want to call your attention to John, the forerunner of Christ. On hearing the news of the death of the king Joseph brings Jesus back to Nazareth, and there …”
